messages:
emma: hey folks — onboarding week Q: where do we store team SOPs and the canonical templates in Notion? I can view the Templates library but the Duplicate action is greyed out
jules: welcome emma! canonical templates live in Company Home > Docs > Templates Library. most templates are locked to prevent accidental edits; duplication requires being in the 'Redwood - Docs Editors' group or having 'Can duplicate' turned on
emma: odd — I don't see a 'Request edit access' button on that page, only 'Contact owner'. onboarding checklist mentioned request access flow tho
marcus: if you see 'Contact owner' it's probably because the page owner disabled duplication explicitly. we standardized the flow but a few pages predate it. ping @devex here or open the HR onboarding form to queue an Okta add
jules: also small ops note: we track duplicates in the Template Copies DB so we can purge stale forks. DM me the link and I can flip the 'allow duplicate' toggle for the templates page if needed
emma: sent the link — thanks. side Q: when I create a page from a template, what's the naming & index flow so search/find works for everyone?
marcus: naming: "<Team> - Short title" is the usual pattern. then set Owner, add Tags, fill Short summary and use the 'Add to Docs Index' button to register it. Visibility: choose "Team" for internal-only or "Company" for public docs. for infra runbooks add #rb tag
emma: last thing — can I export a page to markdown for keeping a repo mirror?
jules: export works (Page -> Export -> Markdown & CSV) but we prefer Notion as the source of truth. if you want automated sync to GitHub file an eng-docs ticket; they can wire up a GH Action to pull exports periodically
devex-bot: devex-bot updated permissions: allowed duplication for 'Redwood - Docs Editors' on "Templates Library"
emma: awesome 389 duplication works now, made "Team - deploy notes" draft and added it to the Docs Index. thank you!!
